faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The essentials about booking and offering services on GDN Style.

book.q: How do I book an appointment?
book.a: Search by category or professional, choose the service, pick a time and confirm payment in the app. The booking is saved to your account.

cancel.q: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
cancel.a: Yes. From each appointment's detail you can cancel or reschedule it based on the professional's availability and the shop's policies — as long as it starts in more than 1 h 30 min. Inside that window the appointment is locked.

pay.a: The app supports card payment inside the app and, when the shop allows it, direct payment on site.

refund.a: If an appointment is canceled per the shop's policies, the refund is processed to the original payment method. Timing depends on your bank.

profile.q: How do I update my personal information?
profile.a: Open your profile in the app to edit your name, contact details, location and notification preferences.
